data.name: Holiday Inn Express Villahermosa Tabasco 2000 by IHG
data.address: Circuito Interior, Perif. Carlos Pellicer Cámara 3916, Col. Tabasco 2000, 86035 Villahermosa, Tab., Mexico
data.description:
Set 2 km from the Villahermosa Convention Center, this unpretentious hotel in the business district is 3 km from the open-air Parque Museo La Venta. It’s 17 km from Villahermosa International Airport.
The streamlined rooms feature free Wi-Fi, desks and flat-screen TVs, plus tea and coffeemaking facilities. Some rooms have minifridges. Suites and club rooms add meeting rooms and/or snacks and drinks.
Complimentary amenities include a breakfast buffet and parking, as well as an area shuttle. There’s a fitness room and a business center, in addition to 2 outdoor pools (1 for kids), a coin-operated laundry and BBQs.
